name: import-step-inches
description: The same STEP file with its length unit changed to inches by hand (a CONVERSION_BASED_UNIT of 25.4 mm), so every number in it is inches: 60 x 30 x 4 in with a 5 in hole. Read in mm, it's 25.4 times bigger: volume 7121.460184 * 25.4^3 = 116699823.81 mm^3, area 4343.561945 * 25.4^2 = 2802292.42 mm^2, bounds 1524 x 762 x 101.6 mm.
